# Semantic-layer metrics

Metric definitions from the dbt semantic layer (MetricFlow). These are the
canonical definitions — a query answering a metric question should reproduce
the definition below, not invent a variant (one metric, one definition).

Each metric that compiles is also an MDL **view** of the same name:
`SELECT * FROM <metric>` through the engine returns the governed series
(metric_time, value). Prefer the view over re-deriving the SQL.

## contribution_margin

Label: Contribution Margin
Type: simple
Definition: Sum of ContributionValue (sold value minus estimated item cost) on invoice lines.
Filter: `{{ Dimension('sales_line__document_type') }} = 'Invoice'`

## contribution_margin_pct

Label: Contribution Margin %
Type: ratio
Definition: Contribution margin over invoiced sales, invoice lines only.
Ratio: `contribution_margin` / `invoiced_sales`

## invoice_count

Label: Invoices
Type: simple
Definition: Count of invoice documents, customer and supplier combined.

## invoiced_sales

Label: Invoiced Sales
Type: simple
Definition: Sum of SalesValue over invoice lines only (document_type = 'Invoice'). Tenant DefaultCurrency; not converted across currencies — group by sales_line__default_currency before comparing tenants.
Filter: `{{ Dimension('sales_line__document_type') }} = 'Invoice'`

## invoiced_sales_mtd

Label: Invoiced Sales (Month to Date)
Type: cumulative
Definition: Invoiced sales accumulated from the start of the calendar month.
Filter: `{{ Dimension('sales_line__document_type') }} = 'Invoice'`

## order_intake

Label: Order Intake
Type: simple
Definition: Sum of SalesValue over order lines (document_type = 'Order').
Filter: `{{ Dimension('sales_line__document_type') }} = 'Order'`

## overdue_invoice_count

Label: Overdue Invoices
Type: simple
Definition: Count of invoice documents currently flagged due (due = 'isDue').
Filter: `{{ Dimension('invoice__due') }} = 'isDue'`

## overdue_invoice_share

Label: Overdue Invoice Share
Type: ratio
Definition: Overdue invoices as a share of all invoices.
Ratio: `overdue_invoice_count` / `invoice_count`
